title: Embedding into a quasi-coherent module pushed forward from an affine cover
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact scheme over a field k with affine diagonal [def-weil-field] [def-pc-scheme], and F a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. There exist an affine scheme U, an affine morphism j: U → X, a quasi-coherent O_U-module G, and a monomorphism F → j_*G. This is the geometric construction only, without a cohomological vanishing assertion.

source.place: Tag 0BDY, proof of Lemma 30.4.3 (1), finite affine cover and stalk-injective adjunction unit; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BDY

proof.text: Choose a finite affine open cover of X using quasi-compactness. Let U be the finite coproduct of the affine members, and j its morphism to X. The finite coproduct is affine, including the empty coproduct when X is empty.

The preimage of an affine open V under j is the finite disjoint union of its intersections with the cover members. The affine-diagonal intersection criterion over Spec k makes each intersection affine. Finite affine coproducts are affine, so j is affine.

Set G to the actual tensor pullback j*F and use the pullback-pushforward adjunction unit i: F → j_*G. Pullback preserves quasi-coherence. For each x in X choose a cover member containing it. Evaluation in its copy in U followed by the open-immersion stalk identification gives a left inverse to i_x. Hence i is injective on every stalk and is a monomorphism. On the empty scheme this condition is vacuous. No acyclicity is asserted here.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_cover_module_embedding (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [CompactSpace X]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (j : U ⟶ X)
      (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toRingedSpace)),
      IsAffine U ∧ IsAffineHom j ∧ G.IsQuasicoherent ∧
        ∃ i : F ⟶ (Modules.pushforward j).obj G, Mono i
